Documenting EDSA by sketching

Artist Nadja Ginete of Urban Sketchers Quezon City documents the protest on Wednesday, February 25, marking the 40th anniversary of the People Power Revolution with paint and pen.

For Ginete, sketching is both expression and remembrance.

Born a year after the 1986 uprising to activist parents, she says drawing the event is her way to demand change. | James Patrick Cruz/Rappler https://t.co/2rzPVgjEpN
